analyst_view.overall: Angers (15th) have gone four league games without a win and sit just above the relegation places, while Nice have won their last two and scored 12 in their last six. Angers are without striker Amine El Ouazzani and midfielder Bané Diatta. Nice are missing Ali Abdi, still working back to fitness, along with Mendy and Bombito. Stéphane Gilli's Angers usually sit in a compact 4-1-4-1, against a Nice side that likes the ball.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals. Nice's attack (Wahi, Amoura and Diop in the expected front three) has been scoring freely, and Angers lose more of their thin attacking threat without El Ouazzani. Angers have also conceded from set pieces more than most, so we lean a little above the site.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.8 corners. Nice should have most of the ball against a deep Angers block, which the model already expects, and nothing in the news shifts that.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards. Geoffrey Kubler referees, and we found no suspensions or bad blood between these sides, so we stay with the site.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.8 shots. Nice's possession pushes their share up while Angers lose some threat without El Ouazzani, so the total should land near the site's figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.3 shots on target. Nice are creating good chances and Angers have been easy to hit at home, so we lean slightly higher.
